summary: One test failed due to a locator not finding the expected element on the contact form page within the timeout period.
rootCause: The test failed because the locator '[data-test="nav-contact"]' did not find any visible element on the page. This indicates that the selector used in the test does not match any element in the application at the time of test execution.

failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' is correct and matches an existing element on the contact form page. Update the selector if the application UI has changed. Additionally, confirm that the page URL and navigation are correct.

recommendations: Review and update the selector '[data-test="nav-contact"]' in the test to match the current application UI.
Confirm that the application page at `${baseURL}/contact` loads correctly and contains the expected elements.
Check for any recent UI changes that might have affected the selector.
If the selector is correct, investigate if the element is conditionally rendered or delayed in loading, and adjust the test accordingly (e.g., increase timeout or wait for navigation).
